request.description: Credential routes allow 20 attempts per minute per client. The pre-request script first sends 20 failed logins for an account that does not exist, so this request is over the limit (to repeat by hand instead, send it 21 times within a minute). Locally the API trusts one proxy hop, so the burst uses a random documentation address (198.51.100.0/24) in `X-Forwarded-For`: it spends that address’s budget, not yours. Behind the AWS load balancer the real client address is used instead.
On the lender from folder 1. HTTPS only, public addresses only (SSRF guard). The signing secret is returned once, here.
